meta_description:
9,347 likes, 60 comments - aarzoo_khurana on October 27, 2026: "Eight months with the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and I have put it through its paces across genres, from wildlife and macro to telephoto and portraits.

The dynamic range in the clouds, the details in an elderly woman’s eyes, the scales of a green vine snake, the tiny eggs of a frog, the textures of water, and the intricate patterns on a peacock’s feathers. Every time, it has delivered beautiful results.

And it is not just about photography. From trips with friends to capturing selfies along the way, I have really enjoyed the selfie camera too.

Here are some of my favourite frames from the last eight months, celebrating the beauty in the little things.

Which one is your favourite?

#collab #GalaxyS26Ultra #TeamGalaxy #withGalaxy @samsungindia".
